content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the Sales Invoice (new) screen, the tab control (click 276) navigates to Sales Invoice (list) (events 279, 285), and users return to Sales Invoice (new) within about 2 s (events 329, 335), a back-and-forth pattern seen in 3 sessions.", "fix": "Fix: on the Sales Invoice (new) screen, change the tab element that routes to Sales Invoice (list) so it does not navigate away from the unsaved form, or open the list in a new tab.", "cited_event_ids": ["276", "279", "285", "329", "335"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The purpose of the tab click (event 276) and why users returned to the form is not in the events.", "The console errors (events 12, 289, 339) have no message text, so their link to the navigation is unverified.", "Whether the back-and-forth is caused by the tab element itself or by a page redirect is not shown.", "Whether the list view is useful to these users is not in the data."]}
